names: Magnesium phosphates (i) monomagnesium phosphate (ii) Dimagnesium phosphate

more_info.overview: Magnesium phosphates is used as an acidity regulator in food. Its technological role is to adjust or control the acidity of food.
more_info.daily_intake: 40 mg phosphorus/kg body weight/day, combined phosphates (EFSA, 2019).
more_info.side_effects:
Estimated combined exposure exceeded the limit in some groups.
Animal evidence supports low acute toxicity.
